component: ZenDB v2.0.1 M1 bounded synthetic benchmark
status: EXECUTED 2026-08-02: the exact pinned harness passed on a fresh ephemeral local DFX replica. This is bounded synthetic evidence only, not a production capacity or instruction-budget approval.

runner.networkBoundary: The runner does not invoke `mops install`, because that Mops CLI command performs an unrelated ICP API compatibility call before it resolves the pinned lock.
